doc: Applies a status-flag transition for a status-effect code passed in a0 (masked to u8): case 0x71 is a full-clear (if either activity bit 0x100 or 0x1000 is set, zero D_800848F8.field8, call func_800552C8 and the two field22-keyed cleanup callbacks; then unconditionally zero D_800848F8.field4, clear both activity bits in D_800847D0.flags1, clear bit 0x2 of D_800847D0.flags2, and re-trigger func_800550E8 if D_800847D0.field26 is armed (!= -1)); case 0xE1 is an activation edge (bit 0x100 -> 0x1000, calling func_8005B070(field22) first); case 0xF1 is the mirrored deactivation edge (bit 0x1000 -> 0x100, calling func_8005B16C(field22) first). Any other code is a no-op. Compiles as a genuine switch statement (gcc lowers the 3 sparse case values via a balanced binary-decision tree: median-equality test on 0xE1 first, then a magnitude compare against 0xE2 to pick the 0x71 vs 0xF1 subtree) — this is what produces the two persistent callee-saved registers ($16/$17): one holds %hi(D_800847D0) reused across a call (needed again afterward for the flags1 read-modify-write), the other is the materialized full pointer reused for field22/flags2/field26 offset accesses within the 0x71 case (needed post-call too), while the E1/F1 cases only need the %hi register (their pointer is transient, used once before the single call).

globals.name: D_800847D0
globals.decl: extern S_800847D0 D_800847D0; (already declared in src/w_800552C8.c and others: flags1@0x00 u32, flags2@0x04 u32, field8..field18 u32 @0x08/0x0C/0x10/0x14/0x18, field1E s16@0x1E, field20 s16@0x20, field22 s16@0x22, field26 s16@0x26, field28 u8@0x28, field30-33 s8@0x30-0x33). This function reads/writes flags1 (0x100 and 0x1000 bits), flags2 (bit 0x2 only, mask -3/0xFFFFFFFD), field22 (s16 arg passed to callbacks), field26 (compared != -1).
